_about: Hand-edited model for porting/progress/progress.py. Leaves with a "measure" are computed; leaves with kind "manual" use the pct you set, with rationale. Weights are manual effort estimates (relative points, roughly engineer-weeks) and set the treemap area. Edit a weight or pct, commit, and the post-commit hook regenerates the dashboard.
definition: 100% = the entire game can be launched into the menu, joined into a game and matchmade on the reconstructed server, and played with sound/audio and visuals 100% working. In other words: the client — the exact same client as the 12.60 original, feature-complete and unstripped, rebuilt as a UE project — reaches the lobby, matchmakes to the reconstructed UE dedicated server (which carries every structure and feature the original dedicated server would have) and plays a match with all visuals and audio. The supplied 12.60 build is the completeness reference; the original binary under Wine is an analysis oracle, not the deliverable.

milestones.text: The client (feature-equivalent to the unstripped 12.60 original) reaches the main menu without EAC/BattlEye
milestones.evidence: Under Wine the original client reaches the frontend login screen (direct_connect_results.md) but needs a manual sign-in; with -AUTH flags it stops at the AppES entitlement gate, which is not bypassed. The native project reaches only the engine Entry and recovered test maps.

milestones.text: The client joins a lobby on the reconstructed server
milestones.evidence: A native client joins the native dedicated server (checksum 683914758, Athena pawn spawned, smoke_join.sh passes). The original client never reaches NMT_Hello (direct_connect_results.md). Generated classes are not yet wire-compatible (native_classes_status.md).

milestones.text: The client matchmakes to the reconstructed UE dedicated server
milestones.evidence: Ticket, websocket, session record and key routes exist in the mock backend and pass a 23-check smoke test (server/README.md); the real client has not been run against them and message shapes are partly guessed.

milestones.text: A full match is played with audio and visuals working
milestones.evidence: No Fortnite gameplay runs; audio playback is untested; the Apollo island is incomplete (map_compatibility.md).

children.name: Native UE 4.25 Linux build, cook and stage
children.rationale: The build, cook and stage path runs end to end. Measured from committed targets and ignored local build outputs.

children.name: Original client starts under Wine
children.rationale: The Shipping exe was run under Wine with bounded probes and exited with code 1 (server_surface.md). No launch to the menu is established.

children.name: EAC and BattlEye bypass for the original client
children.rationale: Separate EAC and BattlEye launcher executables are present. No bypass exists for the original client. The native rebuild omits EAC by construction, which does not count for the original client.

children.name: Rendering backend on Linux (Vulkan)
children.rationale: Software Vulkan (Lavapipe) runs with swapchain and visual captures of terrain, sky and background. Only software rendering has been tested, and Fortnite shaders and materials are mostly absent.

children.name: Pak index decryption and parse (31 paks)
children.rationale: All 31 pak indexes were decrypted and validated (README.md). The count comes from the local inventory.

children.name: Map header parse (3,694 maps)
children.rationale: Every cooked map header was parsed for native imports. Counted from the local census rows.

children.name: Package recovery and conversion coverage
children.rationale: Share of the 450,951 indexed .uasset files that exist locally, either recovered or converted for Linux. Counted from local output folders.

children.name: Static meshes converted for Linux
children.rationale: 76 meshes are converted (61 Apollo grid tiles, 11 background meshes, 4 skybox meshes). The total of static mesh packages referenced by the maps is not enumerated, so no denominator exists.

children.name: Materials (rebuilt approximations)
children.rationale: Original material graphs are absent. Some cloud, backdrop and skybox materials are rebuilt from recovered parameters as approximations.

children.name: Textures (diffuse, masks, baked atlases)
children.rationale: Landscape masks (311), four diffuse textures and 61 baked atlases exist. Textures for the rest of the game are not recovered.

children.name: Landscape weightmaps and streamed components
children.rationale: 221 landscape components are decoded. Streaming landscape levels and the parent level still fail on missing classes.

children.name: Skeletal meshes, animation and character
children.rationale: No skeletal mesh or animation package has loaded in any probe. The Fortnite character is not reconstructed.

children.name: Cooked Blueprint packages load
children.rationale: Four Apollo Blueprint packages were replaced by authored Blueprints that load. The asset registry (cue4inspect --registry, porting/README.md) reports 22,211 Blueprints in total. The original cooked gameplay Blueprints still crash on load.

children.name: Cinematics and sequences
children.rationale: No level sequence or cinematic asset has been tested.

children.name: Native reflection recovery from the decrypted exe (names, parents, structs, enums)
children.rationale: binary_analysis.md sections 6-9: class names for 6,957 of 6,967 UHT blocks, parents verified at 99.76% against UE 4.25 headers, plus 4,512 structs, 2,056 enums and 1,515 delegate signatures. Measures recovery of the tables, not rebuilt behaviour. Ten blocks remain unnamed.

children.name: Maps that enter play in the Linux runtime
children.rationale: FortniteEmptyDedicated and Skybox_Outpost_HomeBase enter play. The partial Apollo_Terrain is not counted, since it lacks streamed levels.

children.name: Apollo terrain tiles (geometry and collision)
children.rationale: All 61 nonempty tiles are converted with collision and visual proxy atlases. The count is capped at 35 because original materials, landscape fidelity and streamed levels are unverified.

children.name: Apollo_Background meshes and placements
children.rationale: 27 of 32 placements spawn as replicated native actors. The count is capped at 30 because the meshes are placeholders and visual parity is unverified. Placements are recorded in the converted list.

children.name: Sky, clouds and backdrop
children.rationale: A sky atmosphere replaces the black background. A simplified cloud and three backdrop materials render. The aurora and the Fortnite sky system are absent.

children.name: Apollo streamed levels (87)
children.rationale: None of the 87 streamed levels load (map_compatibility.md).

children.name: POIs and POI maps
children.rationale: The POI Blueprints fail while their cooked scripts load. The POI manager is an empty native class. No POI map enters play.

children.name: Weapons and firing
children.rationale: No weapon class is imported by any map header, so the census cannot measure this group. No weapon class is declared natively.

children.name: Storm and safe zone
children.rationale: FortSafeZoneStorm exists as an empty native stub, which is not counted as behaviour. Storm classes are not imported by map headers, so the census cannot measure the group.

children.name: Battle bus, skydiving and gliding
children.rationale: No battle bus, aircraft, glider or parachute class exists natively. The skydiving shadow proxy stub is visual only and is counted under visuals.

children.name: Blueprint gameplay logic (behaviour, not load)
children.rationale: No original Blueprint behaviour has been reproduced. cue4inspect pseudocode is partial and unresolved.

children.name: Reflection-exact native classes (/Script/FortniteGame, generated)
children.rationale: native_classes_status.md: 164 of the 2,842 classes in /Script/FortniteGame are generated with original parents, property order and replication flags (plus 4 PlayspaceFramework). Property and RPC layouts are incomplete (767 of 3,424 properties skipped), no function bodies exist, and wire compatibility is not reached. The class total is the named UHT blocks in class_parent_map.json.

children.name: NetCL and network version override (683914758)

checks.label: Version override bound in native source

children.rationale: The Hello checksum is documented. Present in source is not the same as exercised against the client.

children.name: MagicHeader 1110 on client and server
children.rationale: Documented as required in original_client_net_protocol.md. Not exercised against the original client.

children.name: AES and Oodle packet handler configuration
children.rationale: Configuration strings are in place. The handshake has not been exercised with the original client.

children.name: Encryption token delegate and key route

checks.label: Session key route answered by server

children.rationale: Hooks are declared. Key validity is not tested against the client.

children.name: Native client joins native dedicated server
children.rationale: A local UE join to the Apollo and empty maps is verified with a native client. The original client handshake is not verified, so this is a partial result.

children.name: Original client joins the reconstructed server
children.rationale: Not reached. The Hello, Login, Welcome and Join sequence is unverified against the original client.

children.name: Replicated class layout parity
children.rationale: Property order, RPC index and struct layouts must match the original. Only the native stubs exist, and their property sets are not recovered.

children.name: Class checksum parity
children.rationale: No ClassChecksum comparison has been run against the original client.

children.name: Server replication graph
children.rationale: The original server replication graph is server-only and not started.

children.name: Version check and lightswitch
children.rationale: Committed server code only. Uncommitted stubs do not count. Answers are canned.

children.name: OAuth and account routes
children.rationale: Route coverage by prefix: the template's literal path must appear in committed server code. Canned responses are credited at 50%.

children.name: Matchmaking ticket and session routes
children.rationale: Ticket, session and account key routes. No websocket and no session flow exist yet.

children.name: Game v2 profile, world, chat and voice routes
children.rationale: Profile, world, enabled features, chat, voice and twitch routes. Only the stub answers exist.

children.name: Public catalog, payment and asset routes
children.rationale: Store, asset, lookup and payment routes. No real catalog behaviour is reproduced.

children.name: Party and XMPP

checks.label: Party or XMPP referenced in committed server code

children.rationale: XMPP is a large extra backend (original_client_net_protocol.md section 3). Nothing is implemented.

children.name: Party and lobby beacons, session discovery
children.rationale: Beacon hosts and the session record are not implemented.

children.name: Stats, events, cloud storage and datarouter
children.rationale: Only canned empty responses exist for these routes.

children.name: Sound classes and mixes load
children.rationale: Only Master.Master is logged as loaded (asset_compatibility.md). The documented sound-class package set is 292 packages in FortSoundClassesAndModes plus 14 in Athena/Sounds/Events/SoundClasses, 306 in total. Mixes beyond that have not been checked.

children.name: Audio playback on the Linux runtime
children.rationale: Every probe ran with -nosound. No audio device output has been heard or measured.

children.name: Sound cues, music and ambience
children.rationale: No cue or music asset has been played back.

children.name: Voice chat
children.rationale: Voice routes are listed but not implemented.

children.name: Lighting and shadows
children.rationale: A sun light and a temporary replicated light exist. The shadow proxy Blueprint is not recovered.

children.name: Post-process and renderer settings parity
children.rationale: Fortnite post-process and renderer configuration is not reproduced.

children.name: VFX, particles and Niagara
children.rationale: No Niagara or particle assets have loaded.

children.name: UMG and CommonUI native modules
children.rationale: A 64x64 UI texture loads. CommonUI and FortniteUI are absent, and a UI Blueprint fails on a missing CommonButton function.

children.name: Frontend menus and lobby flow
children.rationale: No main menu, lobby or matchmaking UI is reproduced.

children.name: In-match HUD
children.rationale: No HUD is reproduced.

children.name: /Script/FortniteUI native classes
children.rationale: class_parent_map.json lists 1,681 named classes in /Script/FortniteUI. None is generated yet; ui_audio_census.md covers the widget side. CommonUI and other plugin modules are also absent from the engine tree.
